prompt: Use case: photorealistic-natural. Asset type: transparent VFX sprite for a top-down coastal Android app animation. Primary request: one vertical ocean breaking wave seen strictly from directly overhead. Tall portrait 2:3 composition. A sinuous scalloped frothy WHITE crest runs vertically down the LEFT quarter, rolling toward the LEFT; a rich translucent turquoise water sheet trails to the RIGHT and softly dissolves into genuine alpha transparency. Both top and bottom ends taper naturally into scattered foam, all spray isolated on alpha. Real seawater with fine broken foam lace, entrained tiny bubbles, watery depth, restrained sunlight caustics, streaks of receding wash and natural irregularities. Water rather than a solid white wall. No side-view surf curl, no horizontal wave, no horizon, no beach or sand, no background rectangle, no lettering, no borders. Fine photographic seafoam detail and soft translucent aqua edges, not a cartoon, not a vector graphic, not plastic. The crest should remain inside the image with transparent padding left, top and bottom so it can move and deform without rectangular clipping.
